cases.preparationDecision: Four portions. Preserve original dry-fry/wok order, every gram and all sauce. Bind600g to KoRo ready-in-water fettuccine weighed AFTER draining; bind15g dark sauce to Yutaka18L exact formulation (NOT a brand recommendation or an already specified product). Plain chicken breast; no marinade. Ordinary soy uses named AFCD commercial proxy. No starch cooking water from other noodles. No optional omitted garnishes added.
